what: Real Codex account switches on a clean stock Windows Hermes install, through the installed plugin. Two through the plugin's own API, one entirely through the Desktop interface.
machine: Hyper-V test machine switcher-test, Windows 11 Pro 25H2 build 26200; Hermes v0.21.5+3840.g9a0a162 (upstream 9a0a1625367242596d338ae2da541c4a1fc785a2) installed by a normal signed-in user with the official source script
plugin_archive: codex-account-switch-1.2.0-rc.3.zip (development build, uncommitted working tree on dce3d85)
settings: gateway_service null (stock), two Codex accounts keyed personal and gmail, no Claude accounts
accounts: two real Codex logins enrolled on the test machine by their owner through Hermes's device sign-in; identities confirmed by the email inside each login; nothing copied from the owner's PC

warnings: Switch verified; OpenAI quota re-check failed afterwards: Could not confirm the selected Codex account with OpenAI.

switches.route: Desktop interface: status-bar badge, dialog, account selector, Switch account button (mouse and keyboard only)
switches.dialog_before_switch: No active Hermes work blocked the restart check.

answered_by_these_runs: a gateway started by the switch worker while Desktop is closed stays up
the plugin's backend API mounts on stock Hermes and its gate installs on the real dispatcher
the Desktop half loads once the user turns on its switch under Capabilities > Plugins
defects_found_and_fixed_on_the_way: installer kept its rollback copy under plugins/, where Hermes loaded it as a duplicate plugin and rejected the real one
installer refused every update after the plugin's first run because of Python's __pycache__ files
backend discovery required --profile; a stock single-profile backend has none
the preflight route called its own backend over HTTP and waited on itself for 8.6 s, then reported 'not responding'
the switch worker inherited the backend's PYTHONPATH; importing Hermes then relaunched and exited the worker (SystemExit) before its first check
the worker caught Exception, not BaseException, so that exit left the receipt at 'accepted' forever
not_covered: a model request after the switch, to prove which account OpenAI actually bills
refusal cases through the interface: busy session, wrong or expired login
a failure mid-switch and the recovery path
a Hermes update between two builds
the packaged Desktop app (MSIX) install route
a from-scratch run starting at the clean-windows restore point
cosmetic_notes: the badge renders as dark text on a solid blue button
the badge shows 'Claude: Unset' even when no Claude account is configured
Hermes logs 'Failed to load plugin codex-account-switch: No __init__.py' at every start (the API still mounts)
